call_sessions.call_summary: Windows replacement interest and scheduling: Verify that clear interest in replacement windows moves toward a scheduled home-improvement follow-up. Final state is interested with next action: send calendar invite and notify human home-improvement specialist.

Already replaced windows and no need: Verify that the agent exits politely when the consumer clearly has no current need for new windows. Final state is not-interested with next action: log as not interested and end the call politely.

Eyewear interest but wants information first: Verify that the agent respects an information-first request and stays in maybe-interested. Final state is maybe-interested with next action: send approved information and create later follow-up task.

Prescription question requires human: Verify that a vision-health or prescription question escalates to a human specialist. Final state is needs-human with next action: route to human eyewear specialist.

SD card interest and specialist callback: Verify that a product-fit conversation for SD cards can lead to a scheduled specialist callback. Final state is interested with next action: send calendar invite and notify human product specialist.

Already bought storage cards and not interested: Verify that the agent closes politely when the consumer has no need for more storage accessories. Final state is not-interested with next action: log as not interested and end the call politely.

B2B workflow software interest and demo scheduling: Verify that a positive B2B signal leads to scheduling with a solutions consultant. Final state is interested with next action: send calendar invite and notify human solutions consultant.

Integration and security question requires human: Verify escalation when the lead asks about integration and security details outside the approved AI scope. Final state is needs-human with next action: route to human solutions consultant.
